changed.en-US: Skin preview now uses a 3D-rendered outer layer.
changed.zh-CN: 皮肤预览现在使用 3D 渲染外层。

changed.en-US: Skin preview now has anti-aliased rendering.
changed.zh-CN: 皮肤预览现在具有抗锯齿渲染。

changed.en-US: Disable the translation button when translation is not ready.
changed.zh-CN: 在翻译未就绪时禁用翻译按钮。

changed.en-US: Ctrl+F will no longer trigger the browser's built-in search box.
changed.zh-CN: 现在 Ctrl+F 不会再呼出浏览器自带搜索框。

changed.en-US: Pressing F12 will no longer open DevTools when developer mode is not enabled.
changed.zh-CN: 现在当未启用开发者模式时按下 F12 不会再呼出 DevTools。

changed.en-US: Server population info will now be displayed even when the server version is incompatible.
changed.zh-CN: 现在即使服务器版本不兼容也会显示人数信息。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where updating within the software would not update the version number, causing a loop of automatic updates.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了在软件内更新不会更新版本号导致循环自动更新的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix the issue where update packages on the Windows platform might not send UAC requests when requiring privilege elevation.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 平台上更新包可能不会在需要权限提升时发出 UAC 请求的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix a potential issue where forward slashes (/) may be incorrectly used on the Windows platform.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 平台上可能错误地使用正斜杠（/）的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where not reusing the HTTP client caused slow download speeds.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复不会复用 HTTP 客户端导致下载速度过慢的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix the issue where the global Mutex in RangeOutput causes slow download speeds.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 RangeOutput 全局 Mutex 导致下载速度过慢的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an issue where incorrectly using the official source could lead to slow download speeds.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复可能错误使用官方源导致下载速度过慢的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix the issue where the settings page loads too slowly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复设置页面载入速度过慢的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where the 1.16.5 Forge version failed to start due to a missing LWJGL library.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 1.16.5 Forge 版本因缺少 LWJGL 库导致启动失败的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix the distance issue on the seed map caused by floating point precision.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复种子地图因浮点数精度导致的距离问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix the issue where map tiles rendered by the seed map are inconsistent at different zoom levels.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复种子地图在不同缩放下渲染的地图图块不一致的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix the issue where the spawn point marker on the seed map lacks focused highlighting.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复种子地图出生点标记无焦点突出显示的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where the seed map could not open the biome selector in fullscreen mode.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复种子地图在全屏状态下无法打开群系选择器的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where versions 1.13 ~ 1.18 could not start due to incorrectly obtaining LWJGL information.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复因错误获取 LWJGL 信息导致 1.13 ~ 1.18 版本无法启动的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where translation preference settings could not be saved.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复无法保存翻译偏好设置的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix the issue where the settings page title loads out of sync with the main content.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复设置页标题与主内容不同步加载的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix a performance issue where extra validation caused slower download speeds.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复因额外校验导致下载速度变慢的性能问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of slow download speeds for additional files during import.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复导入时下载额外文件速度慢的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the invalid path issue when importing instances using symbolic links.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复使用符号链接导入实例时的路径非法问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where the same data packages from different worlds were accidentally marked as duplicates.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复将不同世界中的相同数据包被意外标记为重复的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where the top and legs conflicted in rendering during skin preview.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复皮肤预览上衣与腿部渲染冲突的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue where the taskbar icon may not be centered on Windows platforms.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复在 Windows 平台上任务栏图标可能不居中的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an error that occurred when editing instance contents while importing instances via hard links.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复使用符号链接导入实例时编辑实例内容出现错误的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed batch download adaptation issue for Minecraft Assets.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Minecraft Assets 批量下载无法自适应的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed race conditions and redundant downloads in Minecraft Assets temp files.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Minecraft Assets 临时文件异常竞争与重复下载的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed DNS cache not refreshing when DNS is unreachable.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复即使 DNS 不可达也不会刷新 DNS 缓存的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed fallback to re-download on local resource copy failure.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复本地资源复制失败而转为重新下载的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed "Back to Top" button obscuring bottom-right corner content.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复“返回顶部”按钮遮挡右下角内容的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed real-time logs disappearing when switching pages.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复切换页面导致实时日志丢失显示的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fix the issue introduced in 1.9.2 where instances fail to start.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复从 1.9.2 引入的实例无法启动的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the Skin editor failing to open in macOS builds when its embedded editor resources were rejected with a 403 error.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 macOS 构建中皮肤编辑器的嵌入资源被 403 拒绝，导致无法打开的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the path concatenation error when importing instances; the path is no longer constructed from the instance name.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复导入实例拼接路径错误，现在不再从实例名拼接路径。

fixed.en-US: Fix the cmd window appearing after launch.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复启动后显示cmd窗口。

fixed.en-US: Disable global text selection; keep only specific text selectable.
fixed.zh-CN: 全局文字禁止选择，仅保留部分文字可被选中。

fixed.en-US: Unify scrollbar position.
fixed.zh-CN: 统一滚动条位置

added.en-US: Added an Easter egg to the About page! It might be hard to find~
added.zh-CN: 关于页面新增彩蛋！可能较难发现哦~

added.en-US: Added a modpack installation confirmation dialog for Modrinth and CurseForge, with version selection and a custom instance name.
added.zh-CN: Modrinth 与 CurseForge 整合包安装新增确认弹窗，可选择版本并自定义实例名称。

changed.en-US: Modpack installation now shows existing installs and the collision-safe instance folder name before creating a separate instance.
changed.zh-CN: 安装整合包前现在会显示已有安装状态及避免重名冲突后的实例文件夹名称，并可创建独立实例。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the Discover page source selection changing to CurseForge after browsing maps.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复浏览地图后“发现内容”页的来源选择被切换为 CurseForge 的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the right sidebar remaining collapsed after leaving the Settings page.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复从设置页面返回其他页面后右侧边栏仍保持收起的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge showing no content under Discover when no search query is entered — browsing CurseForge now loads content again.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复发现内容页不输入搜索词时 CurseForge 空白无内容的问题，现在打开 CurseForge 来源即可正常浏览内容。

fixed.en-US: Fixed legacy Forge instances (such as Minecraft 1.6.4) failing to launch with a missing-library-path error, because the main artifacts of their native libraries are not published.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复旧版 Forge 实例（如 Minecraft 1.6.4）因原生库主构件不存在而报“库文件缺失”无法启动的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed legacy Forge instances failing to launch because game arguments were passed twice (for example --gameDir), which legacy launch wrappers reject.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复旧版 Forge 实例因启动参数重复传递（如 --gameDir 出现两次）而被旧版启动器拒绝启动的问题。

fixed.en-US: Native libraries are now verified and automatically restored before launch, fixing instances that failed to start with "lwjgl.dll not found" after their native libraries were missing or corrupted.
fixed.zh-CN: 启动前现在会自动校验并恢复原生库，修复原生库缺失或损坏时实例报“找不到 lwjgl.dll”无法启动的问题。

added.en-US: Dependencies in the install confirmation dialog can now be expanded inline to view their description and open the project page.
added.zh-CN: 确认安装弹窗中的依赖项支持展开查看简介，并可打开项目页面。

added.en-US: Added a dependency relationship graph to the Content tab for exploring installed content and its dependencies.
added.zh-CN: 内容页新增依赖关系图，可查看已安装内容及其依赖关系。

added.en-US: Added support for custom instance icons — when an icon file (icon.png/jpg/jpeg/webp) exists in the instance folder, it is now applied as the instance icon.
added.zh-CN: 当实例文件夹下有icon.png/jpg/jpeg/webp时 优先应用此图标。

added.en-US: When a search finds matches by automatically correcting the query, a hint now appears above the results — click the suggested search term to search with it directly.
added.zh-CN: 当搜索未命中时，启动器会自动改写查询词重新搜索，并在结果上方显示提示；点击提示中的建议词可直接用它重新搜索。

added.en-US: Added a Skin editor tool to the Lab for creating and editing Minecraft player skins locally.
added.zh-CN: Lab 新增皮肤编辑工具，可本地创建和编辑 Minecraft 皮肤。

added.en-US: Lab tools can now be favorited: starred tools stay marked and are listed first, with new Favorited / Not favorited filters; favorites and the category filter are remembered between restarts.
added.zh-CN: Lab 工具页新增收藏功能：可收藏常用工具并置顶展示，支持按已收藏/未收藏筛选，收藏状态和分类筛选在重启后会保留。

added.en-US: Added a "Create skin" button to the top right of the Skin selector page that opens the Lab Skin editor tool.
added.zh-CN: 皮肤选择器页面右上角新增「创建皮肤」按钮，点击可打开 Lab 的皮肤编辑器。

changed.en-US: Opening the Settings page now automatically collapses the sidebar to give the settings panel more room.
changed.zh-CN: 打开设置页面时自动收起侧边栏，为设置面板留出更多空间。
自定义背景下实例内容页面悬停折叠项的ui透明度现在被调高。
changed.en-US: Custom background now has higher opacity for hoverable folded items on instance content page.
Improved fuzzy search matching for mods and other content: queries typed without spaces or with hyphens (e.g. sodiumextra, example-mod) now find the right results on both Modrinth and CurseForge.
changed.zh-CN: 改进内容发现页的模糊搜索：无空格或带连字符的搜索词（如 sodiumextra、example-mod）现在能在 Modrinth 和 CurseForge 上找到正确结果。

changed.en-US: Favorited content now shows a solid bookmark icon, making already-saved mods and other resources instantly recognizable next to hollow, not-yet-favorited items.
changed.zh-CN: 已收藏的资源现在显示实心书签图标，一眼即可看出已收藏，不再与空心图标的未收藏资源混淆。

changed.en-US: Redesigned the Lab tools list: each tool is now shown as a card with its cover image, category tag, and an explicit Enter button.
changed.zh-CN: Lab 工具列表改用卡片式布局，展示工具封面、分类标签和「进入」按钮。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an issue where instances with version isolation disabled could not be imported correctly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复未开启版本隔离的实例无法正常导入的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an issue where modpack unlinking was not complete.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了整合包解除关联不彻底的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the instance upgrade page continuously showing Fabric versions as loading when Minecraft and Fabric were already up to date. (issue #415)
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Minecraft 和 Fabric 均已是最新版时，实例升级页面仍持续显示正在加载 Fabric 版本的问题。(issue #415)

fixed.en-US: Fixed the fullscreen toggle in the Schematic Workshop (button and F11) not taking effect — entering fullscreen now expands the 3D view to fill the screen, hides the surrounding interface, and leaves the exit-fullscreen button in place.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复投影工坊全屏不生效的问题（按钮和 F11 均无效）：进入全屏后 3D 视图铺满屏幕并隐藏周边界面，原位置保留退出全屏按钮。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the post-update announcement not showing on Windows after the launcher updates — it now appears after the updated launcher relaunches.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Windows 端更新启动器后不弹出更新公告的问题，更新并重启后现在会正常显示更新公告。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of when clicking curseforge modpack title to enter modpack information page, the launcher will show Error loading project. (issue #405)
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了点击 CurseForge 整合包标题进入整合包信息页时，启动器会显示Error loading project的问题。(issue #405)
实例名含非 ASCII 字符（™）导致启动崩溃InvalidPathException(issue #397)
fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of instance name containing non-ASCII characters (™) causing the launcher to crash with InvalidPathException(issue #397)
Fixed the Downloads page layout when there are no tasks: the empty-state card now fills the available space instead of splitting the page between themed and transparent areas. (issue #239)
fixed.zh-CN: 修复下载页无任务时的排版问题：空状态卡片现在会占满剩余空间，不再出现主题色与透明区域各半的割裂布局。(issue #239)

added.en-US: Added an instance core editor for managing loader components and custom core JAR files.
added.zh-CN: 新增实例核心编辑功能，可管理加载器组件和自定义核心 JAR 文件。

added.en-US: Added MCArchive as a content source for browsing and importing archived Minecraft releases.
added.zh-CN: 新增 MCArchive 内容源，支持浏览和导入 Minecraft 历史版本资源。
添加实例一键升级功能
added.en-US: Added instance upgrade feature
Added CodeFlow as a sponsored AI provider in AI settings, including its official logo, a link to its website, and five built-in GPT-5.4 series models.
added.zh-CN: AI 设置中新增赞助商 CodeFlow，附带官方标识、官网入口及 5 个内置 GPT 系列模型。

added.en-US: Added a dedicated "Sponsored providers" section to the AI provider list, shown between the enabled and disabled providers.
added.zh-CN: AI 提供商列表新增「赞助的供应商」专区，位于已启用与未启用供应商之间。

changed.en-US: Reworked the accent color picker layout: the color options always stay in a single row and adapt to the settings panel width, hiding their labels only when the row is too narrow to fit them.
changed.zh-CN: 优化强调色选择器布局：颜色选项始终单行排列并随面板宽度自适应，仅在空间放不下文字时才隐藏颜色名称。

removed.en-US: Removed the preset palette from the custom accent color panel, keeping the hue slider, hex input, and light/dark theme previews.
removed.zh-CN: 移除了自定义强调色面板中的预设色板，仅保留色相滑块、十六进制输入和深浅主题预览。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the AI provider settings layout so the model selector and the save/test provider buttons are no longer crowded together.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 AI 供应商设置页布局，模型选择器与「保存供应商」「测试供应商」按钮不再挤在一起。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the settings sidebar showing English text in some languages when its translations were pruned by the i18n cleanup.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复设置左侧侧边栏在部分语言下误显示英文的问题，并防止翻译清理再次误删设置项翻译。

fixed.en-US: Urgently fix the NSIS installer package issue.
fixed.zh-CN: 紧急修复nsis安装包问题。

added.en-US: Added server management: create, configure, start, stop, monitor, and manage files for local Minecraft servers.
added.zh-CN: 新增服务器管理功能，可创建、配置、启动、停止、监控和管理本地 Minecraft 服务器文件。

added.en-US: Added Lightweight Mode, which can be enabled in Appearance settings or automatically activated while Minecraft is running to reduce launcher resource use.
added.zh-CN: 新增轻量模式，可在 Minecraft 运行时自动开启以降低启动器资源占用。

added.en-US: Added Lemwood Mirror as a download source, with automatic selection for visitors in mainland China.
added.zh-CN: 新增柠泽镜像下载源，并会为中国大陆访客自动选择。

added.en-US: Added duplicate-content detection before installing content.
added.zh-CN: 新增内容安装前的重复内容检测。

added.en-US: Added pinned Content tab views that remember each instance's sorting and filters between launcher restarts.
added.zh-CN: 内容页现可固定实例视图，在重启启动器后保留各实例的排序和筛选条件。

added.en-US: Added translation for titles and descriptions in project galleries.
added.zh-CN: 项目图库中的图片标题和说明现已支持翻译。

added.en-US: Added direct links to matching MC Mod wiki pages in the Content tab mod menu.
added.zh-CN: 内容页的模组菜单现可直接打开匹配的 MC 百科页面。

changed.en-US: Redesigned Settings with clearer categories, search, and more consistent controls.
changed.zh-CN: 重构设置界面，提供更清晰的分类、搜索和一致的操作控件。

changed.en-US: Improved server setup with automatic Java selection, port-conflict detection, and a guided configuration flow.
changed.zh-CN: 优化服务器创建流程，新增自动 Java 选择、端口冲突检测和引导式配置。

changed.en-US: Improved Content tab sorting with file name options and clearer active filter indicators.
changed.zh-CN: 优化内容页排序，新增文件名排序选项并明确显示生效中的筛选条件。

changed.en-US: Project and version pages now return to the originating instance Content tab when opened from it.
changed.zh-CN: 从内容页打开项目或版本页面后，现在会返回原来的实例内容页。

fixed.en-US: Fixed server installation and management issues, including Fabric and Paper setup failures, terminal encoding, and server settings behavior.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复服务器安装和管理中的问题，包括 Fabric 和 Paper 安装失败、终端编码及服务器设置行为。

fixed.en-US: Fixed mirror update manifests failing to serialize correctly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复镜像更新清单无法正确序列化的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the Discover project gallery sidebar covering images in the image viewer.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复发现内容的项目图库查看器中侧边栏遮挡图片的问题。

added.en-US: Added a community survey entry on the About page.
added.zh-CN: “关于”页面新增调查问卷入口。

added.en-US: Added new translating source —— DeepL.
added.zh-CN: 新增DeepL翻译。

added.en-US: Add support for importing without version isolation enabled.
added.zh-CN: 新增未开启版本隔离的导入支持。

changed.en-US: The official QQ group is now 737601250.
changed.zh-CN: 官方 QQ 群号变更为 737601250。

added.zh-CN: 增加文件 Studio
added.en-US: Added file Studio

fixed.zh-CN: 修复添加了背景图的侧边栏无法正常跟随主题颜色并提供模糊效果的问题。
fixed.en-US: Fixed a bug where the sidebar with a background image was unable to follow the theme color and provide a blurry effect.

fixed.zh-CN: 修复部分情况下无法正常切换背景图片的问题
fixed.en-US: Fixed a bug where the background image could not be switched normally in some cases.
Fixed Forge-based Minecraft instances closing before startup when their loader metadata reused JVM options.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Forge 实例的加载器元数据重复使用 JVM 参数时，会在启动前直接退出的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed early Minecraft startup failures sometimes leaving an empty launcher log instead of the error output.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Minecraft 启动早期失败时启动器日志有时为空、未记录错误输出的问题。

added.en-US: Added Favorites.
added.zh-CN: 新增收藏夹功能。

added.en-US: Added LiteLoader, legacy Fabric, and Cleanroom support for Minecraft 1.8.8.
added.zh-CN: 为 Minecraft 1.8.8 新增 LiteLoader、旧版 Fabric 和 Cleanroom 支持。

added.en-US: Added custom proxy config.
added.zh-CN: 现在支持为启动器配置自定义代理。

fixed.en-US: Fixed when hovering links in browse page will trigger a flashing element behind the left nav bar.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复浏览页面悬停链接时会触发左侧导航栏后面的闪烁元素的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed unknown curseforge ID error when switching mods from curseforge source. (issue #320)
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了从 CurseForge 源切换模组时提示未知 CurseForge ID 的错误。(issue #320)

fixed.en-US: Fixed prerequisite selection so each resolved dependency can be enabled or disabled independently.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复前置解析完成后无法独立启用或禁用前置的问题。

fixed.en-US: The icon picker will now use the icon of the loader by default when creating instance.
fixed.zh-CN: 当创建实例时，图标选择器现在会默认使用加载器的图标。

changed.en-US: Header for instance mod install page is now blurred.
changed.zh-CN: 实例的模组安装页面的标题栏现在会模糊。

changed.en-US: Discover now remembers filters separately for each content type, including manually unlocked instance filters.
changed.zh-CN: 发现内容现在会按内容类型分别记住筛选条件，包括手动解除的实例筛选。

changed.en-US: Moved JVM settings and memory allocation settings to Java Settings.
changed.zh-CN: 将 JVM 设置和内存分配设置移动到 Java 设置。

changed.en-US: Exporting a `.mrpack` now shows a completion notification with an action to open the exported file's folder.
changed.zh-CN: 导出 `.mrpack` 完成后现在会显示通知，并可直接打开导出文件所在目录。

changed.en-US: Refreshed buttons throughout Settings with clearer sizing, emphasis, and interaction feedback.
changed.zh-CN: 更新设置页面中的按钮样式，使尺寸、操作层级和交互反馈更加清晰。

fixed.en-US: Fixed explicitly selected and modpack-pinned files being rejected when CurseForge or Modrinth compatibility metadata did not match the instance.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复明确选择或由整合包固定的文件会因 CurseForge 或 Modrinth 兼容性元数据与实例不匹配而被拒绝的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed modpack and server browsing being restricted by the default instance Minecraft version.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复浏览整合包和服务器时会被默认实例的 Minecraft 版本限制的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed overlapping server metadata and action buttons in compact and grid views on Discover.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复发现内容的紧凑和网格视图中服务器信息与操作按钮重叠的问题。
修复XMCL下载引擎部分情况416的问题。

added.zh-CN: 为存档编辑页面下方选项添加折叠，现在它们默认折叠，并在搜索时展开。
为错误弹窗添加5行截断

added.en-US: Fixed IPv6 server addresses without ports and bracketed IPv6 addresses with custom ports failing to parse.
added.zh-CN: 修复无端口 IPv6 地址以及带自定义端口的方括号 IPv6 地址无法解析的问题。

added.en-US: Fixed server status pings starting before the instance protocol version was available, which could show incorrect or failed results.
added.zh-CN: 修复实例协议版本尚未就绪时便开始服务器状态检测，导致结果错误或检测失败的问题。

added.en-US: Fixed Hardcore worlds from Minecraft 26.1 and newer being identified as normal worlds.
added.zh-CN: 修复 Minecraft 26.1 及更高版本的极限模式世界被识别为普通世界的问题。

added.en-US: Fixed deep-link installs for projects whose slugs contain a `+` character.
added.zh-CN: 修复项目短标识中包含 `+` 字符时无法通过深层链接安装的问题。

added.en-US: Added an instance icon creator with transparent and gradient backgrounds, the original icon set, and a new collection of 3D icons.
added.zh-CN: 新增实例图标生成器，支持透明与渐变背景、原版图标，以及一组新的 3D 图标。

added.en-US: Added start and end layer controls to the Schematic Workshop for viewing selected vertical sections of a build.
added.zh-CN: 投影工坊新增起始层和结束层控制，可查看建筑指定高度范围内的内容。

added.en-US: Added a Storage page with visual disk-usage breakdowns, instance folder details, and symlink-aware reporting.
added.zh-CN: 新增存储页面，提供磁盘占用可视化、实例文件夹明细和符号链接占用说明。

added.en-US: Added Tianpao mirror routes for CurseForge CDN files, with official-source fallback when needed.
added.zh-CN: 为 CurseForge CDN 文件新增 Tianpao 镜像线路，并在需要时回退到官方源。

changed.en-US: Redesigned content downloads with a unified install cart, dependency preview, and duplicate protection across Modrinth and CurseForge.
changed.zh-CN: 重设计内容下载流程，统一安装购物车、前置预览和 Modrinth 与 CurseForge 跨来源重复安装防护。

changed.en-US: Minecraft files now download in parallel, reducing wait times during instance creation and content installation.
changed.zh-CN: Minecraft 文件现在支持并行下载，缩短创建实例和安装内容时的等待时间。

changed.en-US: The right sidebar now remembers its expanded or collapsed state after the launcher restarts.
changed.zh-CN: 右侧边栏现在会记住展开或收起状态，重启启动器后仍会保持。

fixed.en-US: Fixed incompatible JVM garbage-collector arguments by verifying them against the installed Java runtime and falling back automatically.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 JVM 垃圾回收器参数不兼容的问题，现在会根据实际 Java 环境校验参数并自动回退。

fixed.en-US: Fix the issue where the NSIS installer does not exclude reparse points during uninstallation.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 NSIS 程序在卸载时未排除重解析点的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge and Modrinth installs rejecting valid legacy mods when embedded loader metadata was missing or outdated.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 CurseForge 和 Modrinth 安装会因加载器元数据缺失或过时而拒绝有效旧版模组的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed modpack downloads randomly failing when a content refresh removed files that were still being installed.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复下载整合包时，内容刷新误删仍在安装的文件并导致随机下载失败的问题。

added.en-US: Added built-in Terracotta update checks and one-click updates when multiplayer is not running.
added.zh-CN: 新增陶瓦联机内置更新检查，并可在服务停止时一键更新。

added.en-US: Added CurseForge map browsing and installation into existing instances, including recovery for maps that require a manual ZIP download.
added.zh-CN: 新增 CurseForge 地图浏览与安装功能，可直接安装到已有实例，并支持需要手动下载 ZIP 的地图恢复流程。

added.en-US: Added custom grouping to the instance library selection toolbar
added.zh-CN: 为实例库的选择工具栏添加自定义分组功能

added.en-US: Added a compact list view to Discover, showing more projects while keeping metadata and install actions aligned.
added.zh-CN: 发现内容新增紧凑列表视图，能在同一屏内显示更多项目并保持元数据与安装操作对齐。

changed.en-US: Optimized the content page loading for large integration packs, opening now will perform lazy loading updates.
changed.zh-CN: 优化大型整合包的内容页加载，打开现在会进行懒加载更新。

changed.en-US: Batch enabling and disabling content now updates selected items together without repeatedly refreshing the entire list.
changed.zh-CN: 批量启用或禁用内容现在会一次完成选中项更新，不再反复刷新整个列表。

changed.en-US: Improved the right sidebar toggle with a slightly larger handle and smoother expand and collapse animation.
changed.zh-CN: 优化右侧边栏切换按钮，增大手柄尺寸并使展开和收起动画更加平滑。

changed.en-US: Added a Resources setting to control automatic downloads for CurseForge files with distribution restrictions. It is enabled by default and can be disabled to restore manual downloads.
changed.zh-CN: 资源设置新增 CurseForge 受限文件自动下载开关，默认开启；关闭后可恢复手动下载流程。

changed.en-US: Discover now reopens the last content type you browsed, including mods, modpacks, resource packs, data packs, and shaders.
changed.zh-CN: 发现内容现在会记住上次浏览的内容类型，重启后仍会打开对应的模组、整合包、资源包、数据包或光影包。

changed.en-US: The launcher now avoids localizing physical mod filenames
changed.zh-CN: 启动器现在不会对模组文件名进行本地化

changed.en-US: Improved mod prerequisite resolution to target the selected Minecraft and loader versions, resolve nested requirements, and clearly report anything that cannot be resolved.
changed.zh-CN: 优化模组前置解析：现在会严格匹配所选 Minecraft 与加载器版本，解析嵌套前置，并清晰列出无法解析的项目。

removed.en-US: Removed group settings from the instance settings page.
removed.zh-CN: 移除原有实例设置里面的分组设置。

removed.en-US: Removed the deprecated legacy Modal component.
removed.zh-CN: 移除已经废弃的旧 Modal 组件。

fixed.en-US: Fixed popup panels blurring the title bar behind them.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复弹出面板的背景模糊把标题栏也模糊的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed popup panels closing when clicking outside them.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复点击面板外弹出面板就被关闭的问题。

fixed.en-US: Added delete instance functionality to the instance library selection toolbar.
fixed.zh-CN: 为实例库的选择工具栏加入删除实例功能。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge modpack metadata requests when opening the Content tab from cached content.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复从缓存打开内容页时仍会请求 CurseForge 整合包元数据的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed map browsing returning to shaders after restarting, and prevented downloaded maps from being duplicated in the regular content list.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复重启后地图浏览会跳回光影的问题，并避免已下载地图在常规内容列表中重复显示。

fixed.en-US: Fixed installations on protected paths not requesting administrator permission when needed.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复在受保护路径安装时无法正确请求管理员权限的问题。

fixed.en-US: Canonicalized legacy Forge loader versions
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了旧版 Forge 加载器版本无法识别的问题

fixed.en-US: Fixed launcher updates installing to the previous directory after the launcher was moved.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复移动启动器目录后自动更新仍安装到旧目录的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge installs into existing instances not passing the instance target to dependency resolution, which could select an incompatible prerequisite version.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复向已有实例安装 CurseForge 内容时未将实例目标传给前置解析，可能选中不兼容前置版本的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge prerequisite previews showing internal project IDs instead of project names for optional and unavailable prerequisites.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 CurseForge 前置预览会为可选或不可用前置显示内部项目 ID，而非项目名称的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed some forge artifacts cannot be downloaded
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了部分 forge 资源无法下载的问题

fixed.en-US: Added prefix icon to the version display below the instance page title
fixed.zh-CN: 给实例页面标题下方的版本显示添加了前缀图标

fixed.en-US: Fixed discover page card tags not hiding the loader tag when entering from instance install content
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了内容发现页卡片标签从实例安装内容进入时不隐藏加载器标签的问题

added.en-US: Discover now remembers the last selected content source (Modrinth, CurseForge, or all sources), reopening on the previously used platform instead of resetting.
added.zh-CN: “发现内容”板块现在会记住上次选择的模组来源（Modrinth、CurseForge 或所有来源），再次打开时恢复上次使用的平台，不再重置为所有来源。

added.en-US: Screenshots in the instance screenshots page now load through optimized thumbnails, so large screenshot libraries open faster and use less memory.
added.zh-CN: 实例截图页现在会加载优化后的缩略图，截图较多时打开更快、占用内存更低。

added.en-US: CurseForge install previews now flag dependency versions that may not match the target instance, so incompatible fallback selections are visible before installing.
added.zh-CN: CurseForge 安装预览现在会标记可能与目标实例版本不匹配的依赖版本，在安装前即可看到不兼容的兜底选择。

added.en-US: Added a gallery layout to the Discover page for browsing content with visual thumbnails.
added.zh-CN: 发现内容页新增画廊布局，支持以缩略图形式浏览内容。

added.en-US: Introduced a new download engine and rewrote the old download engine, which should greatly resolve download issues.
added.zh-CN: 引入新的下载引擎和重写旧的下载引擎，现在下载问题应该得到很大程度上解决。

changed.en-US: Optimized the category menu in settings.
changed.zh-CN: 优化了设置中的分类菜单。

changed.en-US: Redesigned the "About" page.
changed.zh-CN: 重新设计了“关于”页面。

changed.en-US: Optimized dependency-related handling logic.
changed.zh-CN: 优化依赖相关处理逻辑。

changed.en-US: CurseForge managed modpack version switching now runs as a tracked download task like Modrinth updates, with real progress, success and failure notifications, and automatic resume after manually downloaded files are imported.
changed.zh-CN: CurseForge 整合包切换版本现在会像 Modrinth 更新一样作为可跟踪的下载任务运行，显示真实进度与成功/失败通知，并可在手动下载的文件补齐后自动继续。

changed.en-US: Switched Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and Quilt version metadata to official sources with Modrinth fallback, providing more complete and up-to-date loader version lists.
changed.zh-CN: Fabric、Forge、NeoForge 和 Quilt 的版本元数据现优先从官方源获取，并在必要时回退至 Modrinth，提供更完整、更及时的加载器版本列表。

changed.en-US: Improved loader version compatibility across instance creation, settings, repair, offline launch, and imported instances, preserving exact loader versions and preventing unintended fallback to newer releases.
changed.zh-CN: 改进了实例创建、设置、修复、离线启动和实例导入中的加载器版本兼容性，保留精确的加载器版本，并避免意外回退到更新版本。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge modpack version switching appearing to do nothing after confirmation; errors are now reported and the switch is tracked in the download manager.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 CurseForge 整合包确认切换版本后看起来毫无反应的问题；现在会显示错误信息，并在下载管理器中跟踪切换进度。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge modpack update progress staying stuck while the launcher calibrated the pack before downloading.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 CurseForge 整合包更新在下载前校准阶段进度一直不动的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge modpack version lists only showing the latest 50 files; all published versions now appear and the currently installed version is always included.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 CurseForge 整合包版本列表只显示最新 50 个文件的问题；现在会显示全部已发布版本，并始终包含当前安装的版本。

fixed.en-US: Fixed modal close buttons shifting out of place in merged-header dialogs.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复合并式标题栏弹窗中关闭按钮位置偏移的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed day buttons in the home page calendar widget being partially obscured by overlapping elements.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复主页日历组件内天数按钮会被遮挡的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed truncated titles faintly visible in the Discover page, improving text clipping and layout boundaries.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复发现内容页隐约能看到截断的标题的问题，优化了文本裁剪和布局边界。

fixed.en-US: Fixed loader tags not displaying on the Discover page, so mod loader labels now appear correctly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复发现内容页不显示加载器标签的问题，现在模组加载器标签可以正常显示。

added.en-US: Added logshare.cn log sharing and AI log analysis features, and optimized the log viewer page.
added.zh-CN: 新增logshare.cn的日志分享和AI日志分析功能，优化了日志查看器页面。

added.en-US: Added automatic recovery for interrupted CurseForge manual-download installations, allowing incomplete modpack installs to safely continue after restarting the launcher.
added.zh-CN: 新增 CurseForge 手动下载安装任务的自动恢复机制，启动器重启后也能安全恢复并继续未完成的整合包安装。

added.en-US: Added instance content filtering, allowing users to filter instance content by type, source, and other metadata.
added.zh-CN: 新增实例内容筛选功能。

added.en-US: Added data pack management features.
added.zh-CN: 新增数据包管理功能。

added.en-US: Datapacks exported from the recipe generator now have descriptions and icons.
added.zh-CN: 数据包配方生成器导出的数据包现在有了描述和图标。

added.en-US: Added telemetry features.
added.zh-CN: 新增遥测功能

changed.en-US: Changed the sidebar collapse method and optimized the sidebar collapse and expand interaction.
changed.zh-CN: 修改侧边栏折叠方式，优化了侧边栏的收起展开交互。

changed.en-US: Removed duplicate options in the content interface, such as the delete button.
changed.zh-CN: 移除内容界面部分重复的选项，例如删除按钮。

changed.en-US: Added a delete button to the schematic management interface and moved the edit button to a more organized position.
changed.zh-CN: 为投影管理增加删除按钮，移动编辑按钮到整齐的位置。

changed.en-US: Improved the CurseForge missing-file recovery workflow. Manual imports, monitored-folder imports, and the missing-files dialog now use the latest pending state to stay synchronized.
changed.zh-CN: 优化 CurseForge 缺失文件补全流程，手动导入、监听文件夹自动导入与缺失文件窗口现在会基于最新待处理状态保持同步。

changed.en-US: Improved matching for browser-downloaded CurseForge files, including localized file names with title prefixes while retaining strict file verification.
changed.zh-CN: 优化浏览器下载的 CurseForge 文件识别，现在支持带有本地化标题前缀的文件名，同时仍保持严格的文件校验。

changed.en-US: Strengthened CurseForge manual-file verification and import handling to better tolerate concurrent automatic and manual imports without duplicating or incorrectly accepting files.
changed.zh-CN: 加强 CurseForge 手动文件的校验与导入处理，在自动导入与手动导入同时发生时也能更可靠地避免重复导入或错误接受文件。

changed.en-US: Improved the recent projects widget layout: added 3x1 and 3x2 sizes, and hid game mode labels and the metadata separator dot in the 2x1 and 2x2 sizes.
changed.zh-CN: 改进“从最近的项目开始”组件布局：新增 3x1 和 3x2 尺寸，并在 2x1 和 2x2 尺寸下隐藏游戏模式及分隔小圆点。
补齐了部分本地化翻译
changed.en-US: Completed some localizations

fixed.en-US: Fixed cases where an already imported CurseForge file could still be reported as not pending or shown as a verification failure because of stale recovery state.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 CurseForge 文件已经成功导入后，因恢复状态过期仍提示“文件不在待处理列表中”或错误显示为校验失败的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the color picker timing issue in the Gradient Text Generator in the Labs section.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复实验室中“渐变文字生成器”的取色器取色时机问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed stale missing-file records reappearing after refreshing or reopening the missing-content workflow.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复刷新或重新打开缺失内容补全流程后，已经处理完成的缺失文件记录可能再次出现的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed ordinary content installations incorrectly marking an unfinished modpack instance as fully installed while the original installation was still waiting for missing files.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复整合包仍在等待缺失文件时，单独安装其他内容可能错误地将整个实例标记为安装完成的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed install progress leaking between different installation phases, which could cause downloaded bytes from an earlier stage to appear in a later stage.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复不同安装阶段之间的进度数据串用问题，避免上一阶段的已下载大小被错误带入后续阶段。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the download page showing historical download totals as current progress during non-download phases such as resolving the mod loader.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复下载页面在解析加载器等非下载阶段仍将历史下载统计显示为当前进度的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed incorrect download progress displays where the downloaded size could temporarily exceed the total size after skipping or recovering missing content.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复跳过或补全缺失内容后，下载进度可能短暂出现“已下载大小大于总大小”的异常显示。

added.en-US: Emergency fix for DB migration crash.
added.zh-CN: 紧急修复DB migration崩溃。

added.en-US: Added a preferred IP solution for domestic use of Google Translate, now Google Translate can be used in domestic network environments.
added.zh-CN: 为Google翻译的国内使用提供了优选IP方案，现在可以在国内网络环境使用Google翻译了。

fixed.en-US: Fixed unpredictable account ordering when multiple accounts share the same name and login type.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了多个同名同类型账号顺序不固定的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of CurseForge modpacks not showing updates after the latest version was published.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复CurseForge整合包错误显示更新的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of CurseForge resources failing to parse correctly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复CurseForge资源解析错误问题。

changed.en-US: Improved the readability of the duplicate custom UUID error message in the offline account dialog.
changed.zh-CN: 优化了离线账户弹窗中重复自定义 UUID 的错误提示可读性。

changed.en-US: Optimized the filtering function of the instance interface content section, now allowing multiple filter conditions to be selected by holding down ctrl.
changed.zh-CN: 优化实例界面内容板块的筛选功能，现在按住ctrl可多选筛选条件。

changed.en-US: Changed the implementation of automatic switching of instance icons.
changed.zh-CN: 更改了自动切换实例图标的实现方式。

changed.en-US: Refactored the interface for importing instances.
changed.zh-CN: 全新的导入实例的界面，可以自定义更多选项

changed.en-US: Further optimized the download strategy and process to reduce the probability of download failures.
changed.zh-CN: 进一步优化下载策略与流程。

changed.en-US: Optimized the recipe generator page, changing the list to lazy loading to improve performance.
changed.zh-CN: 优化配方生成器页面，列表改为懒加载，提升性能。

added.en-US: Added RedStone multiplayer for creating rooms that friends can join directly.
added.zh-CN: 新增了红石联机，可以让你的好友直接加入你的房间。

added.en-US: Added a settings for enabling/disabling page transitions.
added.zh-CN: 新增启动器设置项, 可开启/关闭页面切换动画。

added.en-US: Added detailed Multiplayer diagnostics and exportable error reports for troubleshooting connection failures.
added.zh-CN: 联机页面新增详细诊断日志与错误报告导出, 便于排查连接失败。

added.en-US: Added a setting for configuring the Mojang authentication service mirror for all possible locations.
added.zh-CN: 为所有可能的地方配置了Mojang service换源设置。

added.en-US: Added support for automatic import of datapacks.
added.zh-CN: 添加对数据包的自动导入支持。

added.en-US: Added a mechanism to reuse existing resources when importing external instances, now avoiding some duplicate downloads.
added.zh-CN: 添加了在导入外部实例时复用已有资源的机制，现在避免一部分重复下载。

added.en-US: Added a targeted project-cache repair and retry action for recoverable CurseForge metadata cache failures.
added.zh-CN: 为可恢复的 CurseForge 项目元数据缓存故障新增定向清理缓存并重试操作。

added.en-US: Added custom public node configuration for Terracotta multiplayer.
added.zh-CN: 新增陶瓦联机自定义公共节点配置。

added.en-US: Now the launcher allows users to skip missing files when importing, and import later.
added.zh-CN: 现在允许用户在遇到缺失文件时选择跳过，后续再导入。

fixed.en-US: Fixed corrupted launcher databases repeatedly showing errors when opening instance content; Axolotl now restores the latest verified backup while preserving the damaged database files.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复启动器数据库损坏后，打开实例内容页会反复报错的问题；现在会从最新且校验正常的备份恢复，并保留损坏的数据库文件。

fixed.en-US: Fixed external Minecraft instance imports occasionally failing with an "i/o error" when duplicate native libraries were extracted concurrently.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复同时导入外部 Minecraft 实例时，重复原生库并发解压可能导致“i/o error”并使导入失败的问题。

fixed.en-US: Refactored the recognition logic when importing resources, fixing the issue of incorrect root directories when importing nested resources.
fixed.zh-CN: 重构了导入资源时的识别逻辑，修复了导入资源嵌套时根目录错误的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the laggy transition animation.
fixed.zh-CN: 优化了页面切换动画的卡顿问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of the loading bar not extending to full screen.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了加载条未能延伸至全屏的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed launch being incorrectly blocked when the custom Java did not match the recommended version; the user-selected Java is now used, with fallback to a compatible runtime when the recommended one is missing.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复自定义 Java 与推荐版本不一致时误阻止启动的问题，现优先使用用户指定 Java，缺失推荐版本时回退至兼容版本。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of the launcher not being able to start when the system language is set to Chinese.
fixed.zh-CN: 针对Github Copilot auto模型做了特殊处理, 现在Github Copilot 免费套餐也可以使用Auto模型。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of the launcher triggering page transitions when switching tabs within a page.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复在页面内切换标签分类时, 启动器会错误触发页面切换动画的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed project platform and tag links not returning to Discover Content with the matching filter applied.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复项目详情页的平台与标签链接无法返回发现内容页并应用对应筛选的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed invalid Multiplayer room codes showing raw internal errors instead of a localized format hint.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复联机房间码格式错误时显示内部原始报错的问题, 现改为本地化格式提示。

fixed.en-US: en-US locales modification to avoid translation overflow in buttons. (issue #212)
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了按钮中的英语翻译过长导致按钮文案溢出的问题。(issue #212)

fixed.en-US: Removed the weird padding of home layout switch (issue #210)
fixed.zh-CN: 移除了主页布局切换按钮的奇怪内边距（issue #210）

fixed.en-US: Fixed: Buttons would be overlapping in the schematic preview edit panel (issue #212)
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了在投影预览编辑面板中按钮重叠的问题。(issue #212)

fixed.en-US: Fixed overflow of directory in the warning of deleting symlink instances
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了删除符号链接实例的警告中提示的目录溢出的问题

fixed.en-US: Fixed the broken live log terminal
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了实时日志无法正常更新的问题

fixed.en-US: When launcher gets a conflicting cache alias from database, it will now resolve cache conflicts automatically, instead of throwing an error.
fixed.zh-CN: 当启动器从数据库获取到冲突的缓存别名时，现在会自动解决缓存冲突，而不是抛出错误。

fixed.en-US: Fixed modpack installations failing after remote project metadata was fetched but could not be written to the local cache.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复远程项目元数据已获取成功、但无法写入本地缓存时导致整合包安装失败的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed instances being shown as ready before installation fully completed, which could trigger incorrect refreshes after a failed install.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复实例在安装完全结束前就显示为可用，导致安装失败后仍可能错误刷新的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed canceling a modpack install during override extraction leaving the new instance and partially installed files behind instead of completing rollback.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复在解压整合包覆盖文件时取消安装，回滚未完成并残留新实例及部分安装文件的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of the recipe generator crashing in some cases.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复配方生成器中部分情况崩溃的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of front-end performance blocking when downloading too many small files.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复在下载小文件过多时造成的前端性能阻塞问题。

added.en-US: Added animation for switching launcher pages
added.zh-CN: 为启动器页面切换添加了动画

fixed.en-US: Fixed cache purging failing when the frontend sends cache types unsupported by the running backend.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复前端发送当前后端不支持的缓存类型时, 清理缓存失败的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed Curseforge import missing files issues
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Curseforge 导入缺失文件问题

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue when after manually added missing files, the download indicator will wrongly show a downloaded size larger than excepted size.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复手动添加缺失文件后, 下载指示器错误显示已下载文件大小大于预期大小的问题

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue when Discord Rich Presence is not reachable, Minecraft can not start properly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复当 Discord Rich Presence 不可用（超时）时, Minecraft 无法正常启动的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed nsis installer not installing the launcher into the correct specified directory.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 nsis 安装程序未能将启动器安装到指定目录的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed Minecraft account name fetch blocking splash screen from closing.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Minecraft 账号名称获取堵塞导致阻止启动器Splash screen关闭的问题。

changed.en-US: When changing theme color, the shadow color of the launcher now changes accordingly
changed.zh-CN: 更改主题颜色时, 现在启动器的阴影颜色也会随之变动

added.en-US: Added JVM argument presets, currently including Fallen’s Mojang authentication service HTTP forwarding.
added.zh-CN: 添加了JVM参数预设功能, 目前内置Fallen的Mojang认证服务HTTP转发。

added.en-US: Added Mojang authentication as a resource mirror configuration to the settings interface, now set to automatic to automatically switch to Fallen’s authentication service when the Mojang authentication service is unavailable. Mitigations include but are not limited to errors such as "Authentication server down" when logging in with a valid account.
added.zh-CN: 将Mojang认证作为资源镜像配置添加到设置界面, 现在设置为自动即可在Mojang认证服务不可用时自动切换到Fallen的认证服务。缓解包括但不限于正版登录时出现“认证服务器宕机”之类的报错。

added.en-US: Added a custom UUID configuration for offline login, along with a UUID copy button to directly copy the UUID.
added.zh-CN: 离线登陆可以配置自定义UUID, 并且添加了UUID复制按钮, 可直接复制UUID。

added.en-US: Added a collapse button for ungrouped instances, allowing users to collapse and hide the list of ungrouped instances.
added.zh-CN: 为未分组的实例添加了折叠按钮, 可以折叠隐藏未分组的实例列表。

added.en-US: Added automatic backup of instance settings to the instance folder, allowing users to restore the instance after a database loss.
added.zh-CN: 数据库将自动备份实例的设置到实例文件夹, 以便在数据库丢失后恢复实例。

added.en-US: Added automatic backup of instance settings to the instance folder, allowing users to restore the instance after a database loss.
added.zh-CN: 支持导入本就是本启动器的实例文件夹, 会完全保留实例设置。

added.en-US: Added a "Auto Import Missing Files" button in Settings. You can also customize the monitoring location. When enabled, the launcher will automatically scan files in the monitoring location and automatically import missing files into the instance when scenarios such as downloading an integration package fail.
added.zh-CN: 在设置中新增了自动导入缺失文件开关按钮, 并可自定义监控位置。当启用时, 启动器会自动扫描监控位置的文件, 并将下载整合包等场景文件下载失败时, 自动把缺失的文件导入到实例中。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of Chinese encoding parsing errors in the Location header returned by mirror sites.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了镜像站返回Location 头中中文编码方式解析错误的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of database records for renamed files being lost during migration, now automatically merging and migrating records based on hash, and rebuilding ownership based on Modrinth hash when original ownership is lost.
fixed.zh-CN: 现在会自动按照hash合并、迁移重命名文件的数据库记录, 在原归属丢失时依据 Modrinth hash 重建归属。

fixed.en-US: Fixed update checks for mods and other instance content using a permanent cache, so newly published updates could stay hidden even after refreshing; refreshing now rechecks the latest versions.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复实例中模组等内容的更新检查使用永久缓存, 发布新版本后刷新仍不显示的问题；现在刷新会重新检查最新版本。

fixed.en-US: Fixed false "update available" badges when the installed file was already included in the target version or the installed version was identified incorrectly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复已安装文件已包含在目标版本中、或当前安装版本被识别错误时, 没有新版本却仍显示“可更新”的问题。

changed.en-US: Removed the shadow around the recipe generator background edge
changed.zh-CN: 移除了配方生成器背景边缘的阴影

changed.en-US: When downloading modpacks and other files, if a mod download fails, the launcher now provides three options to continue downloading the modpack: "Launcher re-download", "Manual import of missing files", and "Monitor folder for automatic import of files". This avoids rolling back the entire download due to a single file failure.
changed.zh-CN: 当下载整合包等文件时, 如果模组下载失败, 现在会提供 启动器重新下载/手动导入缺失文件/监控文件夹自动导入文件 三个选项来继续下载整合包, 避免一个文件下载失败直接全部回滚。

added.en-US: Added zh-cn locales for seed map biome picker
added.zh-CN: 为种子地图中的群系选择器添加了中文本地化

added.en-US: Added progress display for exporting modpacks.
added.zh-CN: 为导出整合包添加了进度显示。

added.en-US: Added a recipe generator in Lab for creating custom crafting tables and other datapacks.
added.zh-CN: 实验室新增配方生成器, 可自制合成表等数据包。

added.en-US: Added a mod translation tool in Lab for translating mod content.
added.zh-CN: 实验室新增模组翻译工具, 可翻译模组内容。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the installer Browse buttons not opening a folder picker when the default destination did not exist yet.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复默认目标目录尚未创建时, 安装程序的“浏览”按钮无法打开文件夹选择器的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the installer remaining open after installation when Launch when complete was selected; it now closes after the launcher starts successfully and stays open if launching fails.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复勾选“完成后启动”时安装程序不会自动退出的问题；启动器成功启动后安装程序会退出, 启动失败时则保留窗口。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of the maximum page number being displayed incorrectly on the search page.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复搜索页面最大页码显示错误的问题

fixed.en-US: Fixed some issues on Linux.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了 Linux 下的一些问题。

changed.en-US: Improved performance when exporting modpacks.
changed.zh-CN: 优化了导出整合包时的性能问题

changed.en-US: Fixed the issue of search result translations being switched from the general translation API to mcim.
changed.zh-CN: 将搜索结果的翻译由通用翻译API切换至mcim

added.en-US: Added AI integrations for translation and launcher assistance.
added.zh-CN: 新增 AI 集成功能, 支持翻译和启动器辅助功能。

changed.en-US: Improved translation logic and AI integration for more consistent results.
changed.zh-CN: 优化翻译逻辑和 AI 集成, 提升翻译结果的一致性。

changed.en-US: Simplified download error dialogs to make failures easier to understand and recover from.
changed.zh-CN: 简化下载错误提示框, 让失败原因和恢复操作更清晰。

changed.en-US: Improved mod-related downloads for more reliable content installation.
changed.zh-CN: 优化模组相关下载, 提升内容安装的可靠性。

fixed.en-US: Fixed downloads failing when the connection was slow but still active.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复网络速度较低但仍在传输时下载失败的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed Minecraft account avatars sometimes remaining on the default skin after startup; failed skin loads now retry automatically and refresh after navigation.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Minecraft 账号头像在启动后偶尔持续显示默认皮肤的问题；皮肤加载失败后现在会自动重试, 并在切换页面时重新获取。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an issue where the import instance window would flash all import options when closed or when clicking the "What can I drop?" button.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了导入实例窗口关闭或点击 我可以拖入什么 按钮时, 全部导入选项闪现的问题

added.en-US: Completely redesigned homepage with widgetized components
added.zh-CN: 完全重新设计主页, 使其小组件化

changed.en-US: Enhanced Windows icon rendering
changed.zh-CN: 优化软件在Windows下图标表现

fixed.en-US: CurseForge files bundled inside a modpack now remain in the modpack group, and existing instances are reconciled automatically without reclassifying user-added content.
fixed.zh-CN: CurseForge 整合包内置的文件现在会正确归入整合包分组；已有实例会自动校准, 且不会误归类用户后来添加的内容。

fixed.en-US: Modpack group rows now fall back to the instance icon when provider artwork is missing.
fixed.zh-CN: 整合包平台图标缺失时, 内容分组现在会正确回落显示实例图标。

fixed.en-US: Fixed local mods without a content record failing to enable or disable.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复未建立内容记录的本地 Mod 无法正常启用或禁用的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed content toggles reverting visually after a mod was successfully enabled or disabled.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Mod 成功启用或禁用后, 内容开关在界面上回弹的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed slow but active downloads being repeatedly canceled when they fell below the route-switching speed threshold; fallback attempts now continue until completion.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复弱网下仍在传输的下载因低于线路切换速度阈值而被反复中止的问题；保底下载现在会持续到完成。

fixed.en-US: Fixed modpack missing-file warnings so affected files are named and can be restored directly; blank CurseForge mirror responses and stale states no longer leave files stuck as missing.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复整合包文件缺失提示：现在会列出具体文件并可直接恢复；CurseForge 镜像空响应和陈旧状态不再导致文件持续显示为缺失。

added.en-US: The world editor can change a world's game mode, difficulty, cheats toggle and seed.
added.zh-CN: 世界编辑器支持修改存档的游戏模式、难度、作弊开关与世界种子。

added.en-US: Game rules can now be edited with localized names, category grouping, search, and one-click reset to the vanilla default.
added.zh-CN: 支持编辑游戏规则：规则名称已本地化, 按分类分组, 可搜索并一键恢复默认值。

added.en-US: The world editor backs up level.dat before saving and stays read-only while the world is open in game.
added.zh-CN: 世界编辑器保存前会自动备份 level.dat, 存档正在游戏中打开时会自动进入只读状态。

added.en-US: Added automatic high-performance GPU selection for Minecraft on Linux, supporting AMD and NVIDIA systems.
added.zh-CN: 新增 Linux 高性能显卡自动选择, 支持 AMD 和 NVIDIA 显卡运行 Minecraft。

changed.en-US: Editing a singleplayer world now opens a full editor page instead of a small dialog.
changed.zh-CN: 单人存档的“编辑”入口从小弹窗升级为完整的编辑页面。

changed.en-US: Improved the Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) interface translation with hundreds of revised entries. Thanks to @DonkeyBear for the contribution.
changed.zh-CN: 改进繁体中文（台湾）界面翻译：修订数百条文案。感谢 @DonkeyBear 的贡献。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an upgrade failure that could prevent the launcher from opening when existing modpack content contained duplicate records.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复旧版整合包内容存在重复记录时升级失败, 导致启动器无法启动的问题。

added.en-US: Minecraft account avatars now render supported skin outer layers with a layered 2D effect and silhouette shadow.
added.zh-CN: Minecraft 账号头像现支持渲染皮肤外层, 并以分层 2D 效果和轮廓阴影显示。

changed.en-US: Reworked instance content management so local files and modpack groups remain visible and manageable when an online provider is unavailable.
changed.zh-CN: 重构实例内容管理, 在线内容提供方不可用时, 本地文件和整合包分组仍会完整显示并可正常管理。

changed.en-US: One-click content updates now update only content added after installation; modpack updates remain separate and preserve added content and local overrides.
changed.zh-CN: 一键更新现在仅更新安装整合包后添加的内容；整合包更新保持独立, 并会保留后装内容和本地覆盖。

changed.en-US: Launcher networking now follows the operating system proxy automatically without a separate proxy toggle.
changed.zh-CN: 启动器网络现在会自动跟随操作系统代理, 无需单独配置代理开关。

fixed.en-US: Fixed Minecraft account avatars sometimes failing to display or shifting when hovering account options.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Minecraft 账号头像偶尔无法显示, 以及悬停账号选项时发生抖动的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an oversized border around the expanded account selector.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复账号选择框展开时出现粗重边框的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge author-restricted files opening invalid download pages, failing to import after browser download, or reporting completion before all files were present.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 CurseForge 作者限制文件打开错误下载页、浏览器下载后无法导入, 以及文件未齐时提前提示完成的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed incorrect content counts and missing-file warnings caused by shader configuration sidecar files being treated as shader packs.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复光影配置附属文件被误识别为光影包, 导致内容数量和文件缺失提示错误的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed content refresh and manual import operations intermittently failing because the local database was locked.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复内容刷新和手动导入偶发因本地数据库锁定而失败的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed incomplete faces on blocks next to observers, redstone dust, lanterns, hoppers, repeaters, extended pistons, and other non-full blocks in Schematic workshop.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了投影工坊中侦测器、红石粉、灯笼、漏斗、中继器、伸出的活塞及其他非完整方块导致相邻方块渲染不全的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the camera occasionally changing direction abruptly during smooth mouse movement in read-only walk preview.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了只读漫游预览中平滑移动鼠标时视角方向偶尔突变的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed walk speed adjustment by scroll wheel conflicting with scrolling the materials list.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了只读漫游预览中滚轮调速与材料列表滚动冲突的问题。

added.en-US: Launcher will now show a discord rich presence binded to Axolotl Launcher.
added.zh-CN: 启动器现在会显示 Axolotl Launcher 的 Discord Rich Presence。

added.en-US: Launcher will now show a discord rich presence with a more detailed status.
added.zh-CN: 启动器现在会显示带有更详细状态的 Discord Rich Presence。

added.en-US: Added download source priority controls and an optional system proxy setting.
added.zh-CN: 新增下载源优先级选项与可选的系统代理设置。

changed.en-US: Improved download routing, concurrency, segmented transfers, and stalled-tail recovery for faster installs.
changed.zh-CN: 优化下载路由、并发、分段传输与慢尾恢复, 提升整体安装速度。

fixed.en-US: Fixed inaccurate speed and ETA reporting and downloads appearing stuck at 99% or 100%.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复下载速度与剩余时间显示不准, 以及进度卡在 99% 或 100% 的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of administrator judgment on Windows not matching actual needs.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了Windows下管理员判断与实际需求不符的问题。

added.en-US: Mods and resource packs that are not linked to an online project now show the icon packed inside the file.
added.zh-CN: 未关联到线上项目的模组与资源包,现在会显示包内自带的图标。

added.en-US: Added a rollback button for content updates, allowing users to revert to the previous version after updating mods, resource packs, and other content.
added.zh-CN: 新增内容更新后悔药,现在更新Mod、资源包等内容后,提供一个按钮可以回退到上一个版本。

added.en-US: Fixed schematics stored in nested folders not being recognized, now they are folded into a hierarchical view.
added.zh-CN: 实例内容页面的投影项右边添加了编辑按钮,可直接导入投影工坊。

changed.en-US: Text in the launcher interface can no longer be selected by mouse by accident; editable fields are still selectable.
changed.zh-CN: 界面文本不再能被鼠标直接选中,避免误选；输入框等可编辑区域不受影响。

changed.en-US: Optimized the caching of empty responses from online sources, which previously would be cached for 30 minutes and caused a poor experience; now empty responses are treated as unavailable, automatically falling back to available sources and updating immediately on next launch.
changed.zh-CN: 优化空返回也会被写入缓存,必须等待30min的不好体验,现在遇到空返回时判断为不可用,自动回退到可用源且下次启动立即更新。

changed.en-US: Refactored and cleaned up legacy code paths for better reliability and easier maintenance.
changed.zh-CN: 重构并清理了部分历史遗留代码,提升稳定性与可维护性。

changed.en-US: Improved nested-folder detection for modpacks and other resources, so files in deeper directories are recognized correctly.
changed.zh-CN: 增强了整合包等资源的嵌套识别,深层目录甚至是压缩包中的文件现在能被正确识别。

changed.en-US: Improved performance when enabling or disabling resources in bulk.
changed.zh-CN: 提升了批量修改资源启用状态时的性能。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of the toggle switch bouncing back when disabling content, now the switch follows correctly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了禁用内容时开关回弹的现象,现在开关正常跟手。

fixed.en-US: The custom system prompt for OpenAI-compatible translation services is now saved correctly and used for translations.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了 OpenAI 兼容翻译服务的自定义系统提示词无法保存的问题,现在会正确保存并在翻译时生效。

fixed.en-US: Fixed legacy Modrinth code so the right-click icon edit button now leads to the correct instance edit page instead of a blank page.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复曾经modrinth遗留代码, 右键图标的编辑按钮现在通向正确的实例编辑界面而非空白页。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the conflict between global drag-and-drop import and the Schematic workshop; dragging and dropping schematic files in the Schematic workshop now imports them directly into the workshop instead of globally.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复全局拖拽导入和投影工坊的打架问题,在投影工坊界面拖拽导入的投影文件现在会直接导入到投影工坊而不是全局导入。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of download tasks not being cancellable, now they can be cancelled normally.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了下载任务无法取消的问题,现在可以正常取消下载任务。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of some files being locked in certain cases.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了部分情况下的文件自锁问题。

fixed.en-US: Forge and NeoForge mods now show their name and icon correctly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了 Forge/NeoForge 模组无法正常显示名称与图标的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed CurseForge projects with more than 50 files showing an incomplete version list; all published versions now appear.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了 CurseForge 项目文件数超过 50 时版本列表不翻页的问题,现在会显示全部已发布版本。

fixed.en-US: Fixed a crash that could occur when uploading files.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了上传文件时可能崩溃的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed schematics stored in nested folders not being recognized, now they are folded into a hierarchical view.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了嵌套在子文件夹中的投影文件无法被识别的问题,现在会折叠分级显示文件层级。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an issue where mods could not be disabled properly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了模组无法被正常关闭的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an OOM issue caused by a low-performance upload interface, which has now been removed.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了低性能的上传接口导致的OOM问题,现在直接移除了这个接口。

fixed.en-US: Fixed an issue where resources were not displayed correctly after adding them without an immediate refresh; a refresh button is now provided to manually refresh the resource list.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了添加资源后没有立即刷新导致的资源显示不正确的问题,现在提供一个刷新按钮来手动刷新资源列表。

fixed.en-US: Resolved several known issues.
fixed.zh-CN: 解决了一些已知问题。

security.en-US: Added extra safeguards for unusual edge cases.
security.zh-CN: 针对部分极端情况增加了安全处理,提升健壮性。

fixed.en-US: Fixed schematics saved with reversed selection axes appearing upside down or mirrored in Schematic workshop.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了使用反向选区轴保存的投影在投影工坊中上下颠倒或镜像的问题。

added.en-US: Imported instances now automatically recognize and set icons based on their mod loader.
added.zh-CN: 导入的实例现在会根据加载器自动识别并设置图标。

added.en-US: Added Schematic workshop in Lab. Open local or instance .litematic and .schem files to inspect builds in 3D, measure and manage layers and materials, edit blocks, and export your work.
added.zh-CN: 实验室新增投影工坊：可打开本地或实例内的 .litematic 和 .schem 文件, 在 3D 工作区查看建筑、测量并管理层级和材料、编辑方块, 以及导出修改后的投影。

changed.en-US: Adjusted the position of source filter buttons on the Discover page for better usability.
changed.zh-CN: 调整了发现页的来源筛选按钮位置, 提升使用体验。

changed.en-US: Manual CurseForge downloads skipped during an installation now remain listed after the task finishes, making them easier to complete later.
changed.zh-CN: 安装过程中跳过的 CurseForge 手动下载现在会在任务完成后保留在列表中, 便于稍后完成。

fixed.en-US: Fixed breadcrumbs not matching the actual page navigation.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了面包屑与实际页面不一致的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed Modrinth update checks so CurseForge-tracked files are not suggested as Modrinth updates, while eligible manually added content can still be matched.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Modrinth 更新检查：由 CurseForge 跟踪的文件不再被当作 Modrinth 更新推荐, 同时符合条件的手动添加内容仍可匹配更新。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of external import of modpacks not being able to update mods with one click
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了外部导入整合包无法一键更新mod的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of CF limiting resource downloads in some cases
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了部分情况下CF限制资源下载提示消失问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed some Chinese copywriting issues.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了部分中文文案。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of disappearing online content
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了联机消失问题

fixed.en-US: Fixed the issue of some code being rolled back
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了部分代码被回滚的情况

fixed.en-US: Fixed some known issues
fixed.zh-CN: 解决了一些已知问题

changed.en-US: Improved download speed for more efficient content installation.
changed.zh-CN: 优化下载速度, 内容安装更加高效。

changed.en-US: Disabled automatic updates in portable mode. Portable users should update manually from GitHub.
changed.zh-CN: 便携模式下禁用自动更新, 便携版用户请前往 GitHub 手动更新。

changed.en-US: Removed automatic redirect to the Create page when no instances exist. Users can now view the empty home page.
changed.zh-CN: 移除了无实例时自动跳转到创建页面的行为, 现在可以正常浏览空白首页。

changed.en-US: Optimized instance page caching to avoid reloading data on every visit.
changed.zh-CN: 优化实例页面缓存机制, 避免每次访问时重新加载数据。

changed.en-US: Enhanced the instance content page refresh button to re-fetch mod online information.
changed.zh-CN: 实例内容页面的刷新按钮现在可以重新获取模组的在线信息。

added.en-US: Added a back-to-top button on the instance content page for easier navigation.
added.zh-CN: 实例内容页面新增回到顶部按钮, 长页面浏览更加便捷。

changed.en-US: Redesigned Java management with clearer default-version controls and a more streamlined download experience.
changed.zh-CN: 优化 Java 管理界面与交互, 更清晰地管理各版本默认 Java, 并简化下载流程。

changed.en-US: Improved the Downloads page layout and actions for easier task management.
changed.zh-CN: 优化下载页面的布局与操作, 下载任务管理更加便捷。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the game version selector being obscured on the Seed Map page.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复种子地图中的游戏版本选择器被意外遮挡的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed Minecraft being incorrectly reported as crashed after a normal exit.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复正常退出游戏后被错误报告为崩溃的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed missing dependencies in macOS builds.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 macOS 构建缺少依赖的问题。

added.en-US: Added Lab with a gradient color generator and a Java Edition Seed Map.
added.zh-CN: 新增实验室, 首批提供渐变颜色生成器和 Java 版种子地图。

changed.en-US: Improved download routing, retries, and progress reporting for more reliable installs.
changed.zh-CN: 优化下载源切换、重试与进度展示, 提升安装下载的稳定性。

changed.en-US: Changed the way the launcher handles modpack parsing.
changed.zh-CN: 重写了加载器版本和类型的解析方式。

changed.en-US: Changed some frontend code left by vibe and replaced it with native components.
changed.zh-CN: 重写了一些vibe留下的其它代码。

changed.en-US: To avoid confusion caused by loaders that have not yet been parsed during batch imports, instances are now imported one by one with progress displayed.
changed.zh-CN: 为避免批量导入过程中还未来得及解析的加载器造成误解, 现在逐个导入实例并显示进度

changed.en-US: Improved the Linux desktop file (.desktop) with Comment, Keywords, StartupWMClass, and StartupNotify fields; added x-scheme-handler/axolotl protocol association and Chinese localization; and set WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 for Exec.
changed.zh-CN: 优化 Linux 桌面文件（.desktop）：补充 Comment、Keywords、StartupWMClass、StartupNotify 等字段, 添加 x-scheme-handler/axolotl 协议关联与中文本地化, 并为 Exec 添加 WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 环境变量。

changed.en-US: Replaced Tauri template variables in the Linux desktop file template with fixed values, ensuring the built .desktop file uses "Axolotl Launcher" directly for its name, icon, and executable.
changed.zh-CN: 将 Linux 桌面文件模板从 Tauri 模板变量格式改为固定值格式, 确保编译后的 .desktop 文件直接使用 "Axolotl Launcher" 作为名称、图标和可执行文件。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the skin page failing to import skins.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了皮肤页面无法导入皮肤的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the import page failing to import instances.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了导入界面无法正常导入的bug。

added.en-US: The offline mode notice now has a refresh button to re-check the session server connection without restarting the launcher.
added.zh-CN: 离线模式提示中新增刷新按钮, 无需重启启动器即可重新检测会话服务器连接状态。

added.en-US: Interrupted downloads of large files now resume from where they left off instead of restarting from zero, including after switching download sources or retrying a failed install.
added.zh-CN: 大文件下载中断后现在会从断点继续, 而不是从头重新下载——切换下载源或重试失败的安装时同样生效。

added.en-US: Project pages now link to the matching MC Mod (mcmod.cn) wiki page — in the sidebar links and the top-right menu — when the project is found in the bundled wiki index. Works for both Modrinth and CurseForge projects.
added.zh-CN: 项目详情页现在会链接到对应的 MC 百科（mcmod.cn）页面——位于侧栏相关链接和右上角菜单中, 仅当项目能在内置百科索引中找到时显示。Modrinth 和 CurseForge 项目均支持。

changed.en-US: Checking a modpack's contents no longer loads the entire pack file into memory; it now streams to the download cache and is reused by a later install of the same version.
changed.zh-CN: 解析整合包内容时不再将整个整合包文件载入内存, 而是流式下载到缓存, 之后安装同一版本时可直接复用。

changed.en-US: Leftover partial download files that have not been touched for a week are now cleaned up automatically on launch.
changed.zh-CN: 启动时会自动清理超过一周未使用的下载临时文件。

fixed.en-US: Fixed a freeze caused by an infinite loop when closing the import method dialog, and its Cancel action is now a real button.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复了关闭导入方式弹窗时因无限循环导致卡死的问题, 同时「取消」现在是真正的按钮。

fixed.en-US: Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge files can now fall back to their official servers when download mirrors are unavailable or have not synced a newly released version yet.
fixed.zh-CN: 当下载镜像不可用或尚未同步新发布的版本时, Forge、Fabric 和 NeoForge 文件现在会回退到官方服务器下载。

fixed.en-US: Servers that mishandle multi-connection downloads are now remembered during a session, so large files stop wasting a doomed segmented attempt before every download.
fixed.zh-CN: 不支持多线程分段下载的服务器现在会在会话内被记住, 大文件不再每次下载都先经历一轮注定失败的分段尝试。

fixed.en-US: Two downloads writing the same file at the same time can no longer corrupt each other’s temporary data.
fixed.zh-CN: 同时写入同一文件的两个下载任务不再会相互破坏临时数据。

fixed.en-US: Importing an instance no longer shows a success notification before the import actually finishes — failures now report an error instead of a false success.
fixed.zh-CN: 导入实例不再在导入真正完成前提示成功——导入失败时现在会提示错误, 而不是错误地提示成功。

fixed.en-US: Changing the app directory now moves shared instance links without moving or copying their original files.
fixed.zh-CN: 更改应用目录时, 现在仅迁移共享实例链接, 不再移动或复制其原始文件。

fixed.en-US: Creating a custom instance once again defaults its icon to the selected mod loader (Fabric, Forge, Quilt, NeoForge) instead of the generic placeholder.
fixed.zh-CN: 创建自定义实例时, 图标重新默认使用所选加载器的图标（Fabric、Forge、Quilt、NeoForge）, 不再是通用占位图。

fixed.en-US: Loader and other newer built-in instance icons now display without the avatar frame, matching the rest of the built-in icons.
fixed.zh-CN: 加载器及其他较新的内置实例图标现在与其余内置图标一致, 不再带边框显示。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the launcher failing to start with a "Cannot save an incomplete Java installation" error when a leftover unfinished Java download was found while changing the app directory or migrating old launcher data.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复更改应用目录或迁移旧启动器数据时, 遗留的未完成 Java 下载会导致启动器无法启动并报 "Cannot save an incomplete Java installation" 错误的问题。

added.en-US: Added a transparent background option in Settings > Appearance, with a slider to control how much of your desktop shows through the launcher window.
added.zh-CN: 设置 > 外观新增「透明背景」选项, 可通过滑块调节桌面透过启动器窗口显示的程度。

added.en-US: Added a background blur toggle for the transparent background, frosting whatever shows through the window.
added.zh-CN: 透明背景新增「背景模糊」开关, 可将透出的画面做磨砂玻璃处理。

added.en-US: Added powerful modpack parsing functionality.
added.zh-CN: 整合包强力解析功能

added.en-US: Automatically set instance icons to match their mod loader.
added.zh-CN: 自动设置实例图标为加载器图标。

fixed.en-US: Fixed frontend display errors during modpack import.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复整合包导入时的前端显示错误

added.en-US: Added translation for new entries, allowing the translation feature to be applied to titles and descriptions outside of entries.
added.zh-CN: 新增条目翻译功能, 让翻译功能可以应用到条目外的标题和介绍。

fixed.en-US: Urgent fix for critical bugs in the previous version
fixed.zh-CN: 紧急修复上个版本严重bug

fixed.en-US: Transient Windows file locks are now retried during downloads, and persistent lock errors identify the process holding the file when Windows can report it.
fixed.zh-CN: 下载时遇到短暂的 Windows 文件占用将自动重试；若持续失败,Windows 能识别时会在错误中显示占用文件的进程。

changed.en-US: Changed the way the module loader is recognized when importing instances, using a more aggressive strategy
changed.zh-CN: 更改导入实例时模组加载器的识别方式,采用更激进的策略。

changed.en-US: Changed the way the import type is detected, using a more conservative strategy
changed.zh-CN: 更改导入类型探测的方式,采用更保守的策略。

changed.en-US: Changed some frontend code left by vibe and replaced it with native components
changed.zh-CN: 修改了一些曾经vibe留下的前端代码,换为原生组件。

changed.en-US: Changed the scanning logic to optimize some parts of the import scanning, improving compatibility.
changed.zh-CN: 修改扫描逻辑, 优化导入扫描的部分石山, 提升兼容性。

added.en-US: Drag and drop mods, resource packs, shader packs, world saves, schematic files, and launcher instances anywhere in the launcher for instant import — no need to navigate menus.
added.zh-CN: 新增全局拖拽功能：直接拖入模组、资源包、光影包、存档、投影文件及启动器, 即可快速导入, 无需在菜单中翻找。

added.en-US: Added schematic file management — import and manage .schematic and .litematica files alongside your mods and worlds.
added.zh-CN: 新增原理图管理：支持导入和管理 .schematic 及 .litematica 格式的结构投影文件。

added.en-US: Added mod import validation — when installing a mod, the launcher now checks if it is compatible with your current Minecraft version and mod loader, and warns you before installing if something does not match.
added.zh-CN: 新增模组导入校验：安装模组时, 启动器会自动检测其与当前 Minecraft 版本和加载器的兼容性, 不匹配时会提前提醒。

added.en-US: Added mod metadata parsing — the launcher can now read mod name, version, supported loader, and other details directly from mod files.
added.zh-CN: 新增 Mod 文件元数据解析：启动器可直接从模组文件中读取名称、版本、适用加载器等信息。

added.en-US: Installed mods in the instance content tab and the modpack content dialog now show bilingual "中文名 (English)" titles under the Simplified Chinese locale, and installed content can be searched in Chinese.
added.zh-CN: 中文界面下, 实例内容页与整合包内容弹窗的已装模组现以「中文名 (英文名)」显示, 并支持用中文搜索已装内容。

added.en-US: Under the Simplified Chinese locale, newly downloaded mods, resource packs, shader packs and data packs are saved as "[中文名]original-name" when a Chinese name is known; unknown files keep their original names and exported modpacks always restore the original file names.
added.zh-CN: 中文界面下, 新下载的模组、资源包、光影包和数据包会以「[中文名]原文件名」保存；查不到中文名时保持原样, 导出整合包时自动还原为原文件名。

added.en-US: Browsing the Discover Content page without searching now also shows bilingual "中文名 (English)" titles under the Simplified Chinese locale, for both Modrinth and CurseForge results.
added.zh-CN: 中文界面下, 「发现内容」页直接浏览（不搜索）时也会显示「中文名 (英文名)」双语标题, Modrinth 与 CurseForge 结果均生效。

added.en-US: The game language now follows the launcher language on the first launch of an instance, including imported modpacks, using the correct language code for each game version; instances you already play keep your in-game choice.
added.zh-CN: 游戏语言现在会在实例首次启动时自动跟随启动器语言（包括导入的整合包）, 并按游戏版本写入正确的语言代码；已游玩过的实例仍保留游戏内的语言设置。

added.en-US: The left sidebar now animates the active highlight sliding between pages when switching sections, matching the content type tabs.
added.zh-CN: 左侧导航栏切换页面时, 选中高亮改为滑动过渡动画, 与顶部内容类型标签栏保持一致。

added.en-US: You can now write a custom system prompt for OpenAI-compatible translation services (Settings > Translation).
added.zh-CN: 现在可以在翻译设置中为 OpenAI 兼容服务编写自定义系统提示词。

added.en-US: Translation results now appear in staggered batches with a smooth floating animation.
added.zh-CN: 翻译结果现在以逐批浮动动画显示, 视觉体验更流畅。

added.en-US: Added a Windows option to use the high-performance GPU for the launcher and Java.
added.zh-CN: 新增 Windows 高性能显卡选项, 可用于启动器和 Java。

added.en-US: Added local Minecraft crash diagnosis and exportable diagnostic reports.
added.zh-CN: 新增本地 Minecraft 崩溃诊断和可导出的诊断报告。

added.en-US: Legacy (1.14 and below), April fools and snapshot versions of Minecraft can now be installed through instance creation.
added.zh-CN: 现在可以通过创建实例安装 Minecraft 的旧版（1.14及以下）、愚人节版和快照版。

added.en-US: Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and Quilt icons will now be auto set.
added.zh-CN: Forge、NeoForge、Fabric 和 Quilt 的图标现在会自动设置。

changed.en-US: Improved modpack import compatibility — more modpack formats are supported and edge cases are handled better, so more modpacks import successfully.
changed.zh-CN: 优化整合包导入兼容性：支持更多整合包格式, 能更好地处理各种特殊情况, 导入成功率更高。

changed.en-US: Improved mod import compatibility — better detection and handling of different mod file types during the import process.
changed.zh-CN: 优化模组导入兼容性：导入时能更准确地识别和处理不同类型的模组文件。

changed.en-US: Java detection is now faster: it reads a metadata file in each installation to determine the version instead of launching a JVM for every candidate, reducing the delay of the first system scan.
changed.zh-CN: 加快 Java 检测：现在优先读取每个安装目录的元数据文件判断版本, 避免为每个候选启动 JVM, 减少首次扫描的耗时。

changed.en-US: Downloading or launching an instance now scans the system for an already-installed Java of the required version before downloading a new runtime, reusing an existing installation instead of downloading a duplicate.
changed.zh-CN: 下载或启动实例时, 现在会先扫描本机是否已安装所需版本的 Java, 找到则复用, 仅在确实没有时才下载新的运行时, 避免重复下载。

changed.en-US: Crash diagnostics now combine related logs and provide direct analysis and export actions.
changed.zh-CN: 崩溃诊断现在会归集相关日志, 并提供直接分析和导出操作。

changed.en-US: The log console and local crash diagnosis are now fully localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
changed.zh-CN: 日志控制台与本地崩溃诊断现已完整支持英语、简体中文和繁体中文。

changed.en-US: Empty log consoles now show Chinese startup guidance with a pink side-view axolotl illustration matching the launcher icon.
changed.zh-CN: 空日志控制台现在会显示中文启动提示, 以及贴近启动器图标的粉色美西螈侧视字符画。

changed.en-US: Translation requests are now sent in batches (5 segments per batch) to reduce API overhead.
changed.zh-CN: 翻译请求现在分批发送（每批5个段落）, 降低 API 调用频率。

changed.en-US: Offline account creation now warns when a Chinese username may be incompatible with Minecraft 1.18 and newer.
changed.zh-CN: 创建离线账户时, 若使用中文用户名, 现在会提示其可能与 Minecraft 1.18 及以上版本不兼容。

fixed.en-US: Fixed some account avatars appearing blank after the launcher starts until the account is selected.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复启动器启动后部分账号头像显示空白、需要切换账号才恢复的问题。

fixed.en-US: Improved large-file download throughput with parallel Range requests, safer retries, and redirect reuse.
fixed.zh-CN: 通过并行 Range 请求、安全重试和重定向复用提升大文件下载速度。

fixed.en-US: Fixed startup failures caused by conflicting Java discovery and onboarding database migrations.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Java 检测与新手引导数据库迁移冲突导致的启动失败。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the accent highlight outline on the Add skin button in the skin selector being clipped on some edges when the button was focused.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复皮肤选择器「添加皮肤」按钮在聚焦时强调色高亮描边部分边缘被裁剪、显示不完整的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed database backups being written to Modrinth's directory; backups are now stored in the launcher's own data directory.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复数据库备份被写入 Modrinth 目录的问题, 现在改为保存到启动器自己的应用数据目录。

fixed.en-US: Improved crash diagnosis when multiple instances fail close together.
fixed.zh-CN: 改进多个实例接连失败时的崩溃诊断。

fixed.en-US: Fixed early Java and loader failures leaving instances stuck while starting.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Java 或加载器早期失败时实例持续卡在启动中的问题。

added.en-US: Expanded Java detection to search JAVA_HOME sibling installations, common vendor locations, official Minecraft Launcher runtimes, and likely installation folders.
added.zh-CN: 扩展 Java 自动检测范围, 现可搜索 JAVA_HOME 同级安装、常见发行版目录、Minecraft 官方启动器运行时及可能的安装目录。

added.en-US: Added automatic memory allocation that adapts to available RAM and installed mods each time an instance launches.
added.zh-CN: 新增自动分配内存, 可在每次启动实例时根据可用内存和已安装模组动态调整。

added.en-US: Added a live memory allocation display and one-click memory optimization on Windows.
added.zh-CN: 新增实时内存分配展示, 并在 Windows 上提供一键内存优化。

changed.en-US: Java detection now caches results, scans sources concurrently, and refreshes the installation list in the background.
changed.zh-CN: Java 检测现在会缓存结果、并行扫描不同来源, 并在后台刷新安装列表。

changed.en-US: The launcher now reuses an already detected Java runtime with the required version before downloading a new one.
changed.zh-CN: 启动实例缺少所需 Java 版本时, 现在会优先复用已检测到的同版本运行时, 再考虑下载新的运行时。

fixed.en-US: Improved memory usage reporting and automatic allocation accuracy on macOS.
fixed.zh-CN: 改进 macOS 上的内存占用显示和自动分配准确性。

fixed.en-US: Fixed Java detection for several Windows registry paths and nested Eclipse Adoptium installation entries.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复部分 Windows 注册表路径及 Eclipse Adoptium 嵌套安装项无法检测 Java 的问题。

added.en-US: Added HMCL, PCL2, and PCL2CE launcher instance import — all instances are now discovered and imported directly from these launchers.
added.zh-CN: 新增 HMCL、PCL2、PCL2CE 启动器实例导入支持, 可直接根据启动器解析出所有实例。

added.en-US: Added generic folder import — any directory containing a .minecraft folder can now be imported as an instance.
added.zh-CN: 新增通用文件夹导入功能, 可导入任意含 .minecraft 的目录。

added.en-US: Added "import as shared instance" support, optionally using symlinks instead of copying to save disk space.
added.zh-CN: 新增添加为共享实例功能：导入时可选软链接而非复制。

added.en-US: Added a confirmation dialog when deleting files from the file browser tab.
added.zh-CN: 补齐文件标签页删除时的确认弹窗。

added.en-US: Added OptiFine support — declared OptiFine in a modpack is automatically installed; standalone, or as a mod alongside other loaders.
added.zh-CN: 新增 OptiFine 支持：整合包声明 OptiFine 时自动安装——单独存在时作为加载器。

added.en-US: Added drag-and-drop import: drop mods, resource packs, shader packs, world saves, schematics, and launcher instances directly onto the launcher for instant import.
added.zh-CN: 新增拖放导入功能：直接拖入模组、资源包、光影包、存档、投影文件及启动器实例, 即可快速导入。

changed.en-US: Optimised copy_dotminecraft_with_reporter: serial copies are now concurrent, reducing time complexity from O(n·t) to O(max(t)), and progress reporting has been improved.
changed.zh-CN: 优化 copy_dotminecraft_with_reporter：串行复制改为并发, 时间复杂度由 O(n·t) 降为 O(max(t)), 优化进度上报时机。

changed.en-US: Updated shared instance indicators and warning hints for clarity.
changed.zh-CN: 更新共享实例标识与警告提示。

changed.en-US: Greatly improved modpack import compatibility — now handles CurseForge, MCBBS, HMCL, MultiMC, PCL launcher-bundled archives and various non-standard pack formats.
changed.zh-CN: 大大增强整合包导入兼容性, 兼容 CurseForge、MCBBS、HMCL、MultiMC、PCL 等导出的附带启动器的整合包以及各种不完全符合规范的整合包格式。

fixed.en-US: Fixed world save import failing with "Invalid instance ID" error due to incorrect UUID parsing of local instance IDs.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复世界存档导入时因实例 ID 的 local: 前缀被错误地当作 UUID 解析而导致的导入失败问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed "[object Object]" being displayed in error notifications instead of the actual error message.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复错误通知中显示 "[object Object]" 而非真实错误信息的问题。

added.en-US: Modpack imports now detect the archive format by content: CurseForge, MCBBS, HMCL, and MultiMC/Prism export packs, launcher-bundled archives, and zipped game folders can be imported alongside .mrpack files.
added.zh-CN: 整合包导入现在按压缩包内容识别格式：除 .mrpack 外, 还支持 CurseForge、MCBBS、HMCL、MultiMC/Prism 导出包、附带启动器的整合包以及打包的游戏目录。

added.en-US: Added OptiFine support: modpacks declaring OptiFine install it automatically, standalone as the loader or as a mod alongside Forge/NeoForge.
added.zh-CN: 新增 OptiFine 支持：声明了 OptiFine 的整合包会自动安装——单独存在时作为加载器, 与 Forge/NeoForge 共存时作为模组安装。

added.en-US: Added an appearance setting to limit the number of recent instances shown in the sidebar, with 0 showing all instances.
added.zh-CN: 新增外观设置, 可限制侧边栏显示的最近实例数量, 设为 0 时显示全部实例。

added.en-US: Added custom accent colors with a preset palette, hue slider, hex input, and automatic light and dark theme variants.
added.zh-CN: 新增自定义强调色, 支持预设色板、色相滑块、十六进制色号及自动生成浅色和深色主题变体。

changed.en-US: Improved the update settings version history with clearer release cards and details.
changed.zh-CN: 优化更新设置中的版本历史, 提供更清晰的发布卡片和详情展示。

changed.en-US: The sidebar instance list now scrolls independently when it exceeds the available space.
changed.zh-CN: 侧边栏实例列表超出可用空间时, 现在可以独立滚动。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the quick instance switcher failing to render when the instance list could not be loaded.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复实例列表加载失败时快速实例切换器无法显示的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed local modpack installs appearing stuck at 100% and hanging when a Minecraft file download stops receiving data.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复本地整合包安装在 100% 后看似卡住, 以及 Minecraft 文件下载停止接收数据时任务无法结束的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the Minecraft download progress overshooting and pegging at 100% early after a download attempt was retried.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复下载重试后 Minecraft 资源下载进度虚高、提前钳制在 100% 的问题。

fixed.en-US: Modpack archives with GB18030 (GBK) encoded Chinese file names now extract correctly.
fixed.zh-CN: 使用 GB18030（GBK）编码中文文件名的整合包压缩包现在可以正确解压。

added.en-US: Added categorized update announcements after app updates and a permanent release history in settings.
added.zh-CN: 新增应用更新后的分类公告弹窗, 以及设置中的永久版本历史记录。

added.en-US: Added a first-run onboarding guide that can also be replayed from settings.
added.zh-CN: 新增首次使用引导, 并支持从设置中重新播放。

changed.en-US: Skipped-download warnings can now be collapsed.
changed.zh-CN: 跳过下载模组的警告窗口现在可以被收起。

changed.en-US: Launcher logs now rotate automatically at 10 MiB and keep up to five files.
changed.zh-CN: 启动器日志现按 10 MiB 自动轮转并最多保留 5 个文件。

changed.en-US: Modrinth request logs now retain the target, source, retry count, and a redacted URL.
changed.zh-CN: Modrinth 请求日志现在保留目标、来源、重试次数和脱敏 URL。

changed.en-US: Large error log exports now use streaming compression to reduce memory usage.
changed.zh-CN: 错误日志导出现在使用流式压缩, 降低大日志导出时的内存占用。

changed.en-US: WARN and ERROR logs now rotate before the 30 MiB boundary without splitting individual events.
changed.zh-CN: WARN 和 ERROR 日志现在会在 30 MiB 边界内保持完整, 轮转时不会拆分单个事件。

changed.en-US: Launcher logs older than three days are now removed automatically.
changed.zh-CN: 启动器日志创建超过三天后现在会自动删除。

fixed.en-US: Fixed skipped mods remaining in the list after manually installing them.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复手动安装跳过下载的模组后, 已跳过模组列表不会更新的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed duplicate download events causing complete installation states to be logged repeatedly.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复下载事件重复记录完整安装状态, 导致启动器日志快速膨胀的问题。

fixed.en-US: Fixed the Fabric/Modrinth content page watcher repeatedly writing the same map and getting stuck loading.
fixed.zh-CN: 修复 Fabric/Modrinth 实例内容页 watcher 重复写入相同 Map, 触发递归更新并持续加载的问题。

security.en-US: Temporary signatures in Modrinth request URLs are no longer written to logs.
security.zh-CN: Modrinth 请求 URL 中的临时签名不再写入日志。
